summary.zh-CN: 12岁男孩，间断咯血1年，出生后就反复长湿疹，收入儿科病房查找咯血原因。
summary.en: A 12-year-old boy with a year of intermittent haemoptysis and eczema since soon after birth is admitted to the children's ward to find the cause of the bleeding.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 对反复咯血的孩子问清病程、次数、每次的量和既往诊治，并在入院时安排SpO₂、血常规、凝血、备血、痰病原学和增强CT加血管重建。
learningOutcomes.en: Take a focused history of recurrent haemoptysis (duration, episodes, volume, earlier work-up) and plan his admission: SpO₂ measured at once, a blood count, clotting, group and save, sputum microbiology and contrast CT with vascular reconstruction.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 解释看不见发绀为什么不等于血氧正常，并对有杵状指、可能存在右向左分流的孩子测SpO₂。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain why absent cyanosis does not establish normal oxygenation, and measure SpO₂ in a child with clubbing and a possible right-to-left shunt.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 识别STAT3高IgE综合征的组合（出生后湿疹、需要手术的化脓性感染、乳牙滞留、极高IgE），并与DOCK8缺陷、Wiskott–Aldrich综合征和慢性肉芽肿病鉴别。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise the STAT3 hyper-IgE syndrome pattern — eczema from soon after birth, a suppurative infection needing surgery, retained primary teeth, a very high IgE — and tell it from DOCK8 deficiency, Wiskott–Aldrich syndrome and chronic granulomatous disease.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 面对结节内有强化血管的CT，不做穿刺活检，转介入放射科做肺动脉和支气管动脉造影并同期栓塞，术前查血小板、预防性使用抗生素。
learningOutcomes.en: Faced with a CT showing enhancing vessels within lung nodules, avoid biopsy and refer for angiography of the pulmonary and bronchial arteries with embolisation, checking platelets and giving antibiotic cover first.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 按Woellner诊断指南（2010）用STAT3测序和父母验证确诊，并向家庭解释这个很可能新发的显性变异的含义。
learningOutcomes.en: Apply the Woellner diagnostic guidelines (2010) to confirm the diagnosis with STAT3 sequencing and parental testing, and explain to the family a dominant variant that most likely arose in him.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 与家人商定出院计划：抗葡萄球菌预防、牙科和有创操作前的抗生素、书面的再咯血计划、遗传咨询和费用上的帮助。
learningOutcomes.en: Agree a discharge plan with the family: anti-staphylococcal prophylaxis, antibiotic cover for dental and invasive procedures, a written bleeding plan, genetic counselling and help with costs.

name.zh-CN: 大咯血预案：床旁备吸引器和氧气、建立静脉通路、交代医护
name.en: Plan for a large bleed: suction and oxygen at the bedside, IV access, staff briefed

dose.zh-CN: 床旁备吸引器和氧气；留置静脉通路；告知护士和值班医生：一旦大咯血，让他患侧朝下侧卧（病变侧明确前取侧卧位），保持气道通畅并立即呼叫上级、麻醉科和介入科。
dose.en: Suction and oxygen at the bedside; an IV cannula in place; the nurse and the on-call team told what to do in a large bleed: lie him on his side, bleeding side down once the side is known, keep the airway clear and call the senior, anaesthesia and interventional radiology at once.

response.zh-CN: 已安排：吸引器和氧气在床旁，静脉通路已建立，医护都知道大咯血时怎么做。住院期间是否再咯血没有记录。
response.en: Done: suction and oxygen are at the bedside, a cannula is in, and the team knows what to do in a large bleed. Whether he bled again during the admission is not recorded.

name.zh-CN: 静脉输液严防进气（尽量使用输液空气过滤器）
name.en: Keep air out of his IV lines (an in-line air filter where possible)

dose.zh-CN: 所有静脉通路排尽空气，尽量加装空气过滤器；向护士说明原因。
dose.en: De-air every IV line, fit an in-line air filter where possible, and tell the nurses why.

response.zh-CN: 已执行：输液管路排尽空气并加装过滤器。可能存在右向左分流时这一点很重要：静脉里的气泡可绕过肺毛细血管进入脑循环。原报告没有记录这项措施。
response.en: Done: the lines are de-aired and filtered — the precaution that matters whenever a right-to-left shunt is possible, because a bubble in a vein can then bypass the lung capillaries and reach the brain. The report does not record this precaution.

name.zh-CN: 请儿童免疫科会诊

dose.zh-CN: 请儿童免疫科评估可疑的原发性免疫缺陷。
dose.en: Ask paediatric immunology to assess a suspected inborn error of immunity.

response.zh-CN: 儿童免疫科会来看他，结合病史和陆续回报的免疫学检查一起评估。
response.en: Paediatric immunology will see him and review his history together with the immune tests as they come back.

name.zh-CN: 转介介入放射科：肺动脉及支气管动脉造影，必要时同期栓塞
name.en: Refer to interventional radiology for pulmonary and bronchial angiography, with embolisation in the same session if needed

dose.zh-CN: 申请肺动脉和支气管（体循环）动脉造影，明确供血血管并同期栓塞；术前先查血小板计数和凝血功能，并为操作预防性使用抗生素。
dose.en: Request angiography of the pulmonary and the bronchial (systemic) arteries to define the feeding vessels and embolise them in the same session; check the platelet count and clotting first and give antibiotic cover for the procedure.

response.zh-CN: 介入放射科会审阅他的影像：血管造影能显示哪些动脉供应出血来源，并可同期栓塞；他们要求术前查血小板计数并预防性使用抗生素。
response.en: Interventional radiology will review his imaging: angiography shows which arteries supply a bleeding source and can embolise them in the same session; they ask for a platelet count and antibiotic cover first.

name.zh-CN: 复方磺胺甲噁唑预防用药（抗葡萄球菌）

dose.zh-CN: 复方磺胺甲噁唑口服，每日2次，按体重给药；先称体重（体重未记录），并确认无磺胺过敏（过敏史未记录）。
dose.en: Oral co-trimoxazole twice daily, dosed by weight; weigh him first (no weight is recorded) and confirm there is no sulfonamide allergy (his allergies are not recorded).

response.zh-CN: 已开具，按体重给药，用药前先称体重并确认过敏史。原报告没有记录预防用药。
response.en: Prescribed, dosed by weight once he has been weighed and his allergies checked. The report does not record any prophylaxis.

name.zh-CN: 牙科及有创操作前预防性使用抗生素；安排口腔科随访
name.en: Antibiotic cover before dental and invasive procedures; dental review

dose.zh-CN: 在病历和出院小结中写明：牙科、内镜和外科操作前预防性使用抗生素；保持口腔卫生，定期口腔科随访。
dose.en: Record in his notes and discharge letter: antibiotic cover before dental, endoscopic and surgical procedures; good dental hygiene and regular dental review.

response.zh-CN: 已写入病历和出院小结，并向家长解释了原因。原报告没有记录这项建议。
response.en: Written into his notes and discharge letter, and the reason explained to his parent. The report does not record this advice.

name.zh-CN: 遗传咨询（患儿及父母）
name.en: Genetic counselling for him and his parents

dose.zh-CN: 由遗传咨询师或遗传科医生解释基因检测结果的含义：对他本人、父母以及将来的孩子。
dose.en: A genetic counsellor or clinical geneticist explains what a genetic result means for him, for his parents and for his future children.

response.zh-CN: 已安排遗传咨询。原报告没有记录遗传咨询。
response.en: Genetic counselling arranged. The report does not record any.

name.zh-CN: 出院安全计划：再咯血时怎么办、找谁、何时叫急救
name.en: Discharge safety plan: what to do if he coughs up blood again, whom to call, when to call an ambulance

dose.zh-CN: 书面告知：再次咯血时侧卧、立即就近急诊或叫急救；随访时间和联系人。
dose.en: In writing: if he coughs up blood again, lie on his side and go to the nearest emergency department or call an ambulance; the follow-up dates and whom to contact.

response.zh-CN: 已书面交代家长和孩子，并请他们复述要点。原报告没有记录出院宣教。
response.en: Given in writing to him and his parent, who repeat the key points back. The report does not record discharge advice.

name.zh-CN: 请社工或医保部门协助解决治疗费用
name.en: Refer to the social worker or the medical-insurance office for help with the cost of treatment

dose.zh-CN: 与家长坦诚讨论费用；由社工或医保部门介绍医保报销和救助渠道。
dose.en: Talk openly with the family about costs; the social worker or the insurance office explains coverage and charitable funds.

response.zh-CN: 社工会和家长一起梳理医保报销和可申请的救助。
response.en: The social worker will go through insurance cover and the funds the family can apply for.

name.zh-CN: 肺活检（CT引导下经皮穿刺或经支气管镜）

dose.zh-CN: CT引导下经皮穿刺（或经支气管镜）对肺部病变取活检。
dose.en: A CT-guided percutaneous (or bronchoscopic) biopsy of a lung lesion.

harm.zh-CN: 对强化如血管的病变穿刺活检，可引起致命性大出血；若存在右向左分流，还可发生脑空气栓塞。BTS肺动静脉畸形临床声明（2017，针对成人）指出：CT阳性即可诊断肺动静脉畸形——血管病变靠影像和血管造影明确，不需要组织学。
harm.en: Needling a lesion that enhances like a blood vessel can cause massive, life-threatening haemorrhage — and, through a right-to-left shunt, air embolism to the brain. The BTS clinical statement on pulmonary AVMs (2017, for adults) holds that a positive CT scan is diagnostic: a vascular lesion is defined by imaging and angiography, not by tissue.

response.zh-CN: 已按医嘱记录为活检申请。

name.zh-CN: 肺部病变手术切除（肺叶切除）
name.en: Surgical resection of the lung lesion (lobectomy)

dose.zh-CN: 胸外科手术切除病变所在肺叶。
dose.en: Thoracic surgery to remove the affected lobe.

harm.zh-CN: 手术会切除本可经栓塞保留的肺组织。BTS肺动静脉畸形临床声明（2017，针对成人）主张：只要技术可行，所有影像可见的肺动静脉畸形都转介栓塞；CIRSE支气管动脉栓塞实践标准（2022）把开胸手术留给破坏性肺病或栓塞失败；STAT3高IgE综合征患者肺部手术易出现支气管胸膜瘘等并发症（Tsilifis等，2021）。
harm.en: Resection removes lung that embolisation could spare. The BTS clinical statement on pulmonary AVMs (2017, for adults) refers every radiologically visible PAVM for embolisation if technically feasible; the CIRSE standards of practice on bronchial artery embolisation (2022) keep open surgery for destructive lung disease or failed embolisation; and in STAT3 hyper-IgE syndrome lung surgery risks complications such as bronchopleural fistula (Tsilifis et al., 2021).

response.zh-CN: 已按医嘱记录为手术申请。

name.zh-CN: 咯血停止后出院，不安排随访
name.en: Discharge once the bleeding has settled, with no follow-up

dose.zh-CN: 出院，不安排呼吸科、免疫科或介入科随访。
dose.en: Discharge with no respiratory, immunology or interventional follow-up.

harm.zh-CN: 血管病变未处理、类型不明；右向左分流的风险不止出血，还有反常栓塞和脑脓肿。BTS肺动静脉畸形临床声明（2017，针对成人）要求在栓塞之外进行药物管理和随访；他的免疫缺陷也需要长期专科管理（AAAAI/ACAAI 2015实践参数：以处理并发症为中心）。
harm.en: The vascular lesion is untreated and its type unknown; a possible right-to-left shunt carries risks beyond bleeding — paradoxical emboli and brain abscess. The BTS clinical statement on pulmonary AVMs (2017, for adults) asks for medical management and follow-up alongside embolisation, and his immune defect is lifelong, with care that the AAAAI/ACAAI practice parameter (2015) directs at its complications.

response.zh-CN: 已按医嘱记录为出院且不随访。

hint.zh-CN: 问他和家长：咯血的次数和量、之前住院的结论，以及出生后的皮肤、严重感染、乳牙和家族情况。
hint.en: Ask him and his parent about the bleeding — how often, how much, what the earlier admission found — and about his skin since birth, serious infections, his teeth and the family.

guidance.zh-CN: 家长讲小时候的事；直接问孩子的问题由他自己回答。
guidance.en: His parent tells the story of his early childhood; questions put to the boy he answers himself.

hint.zh-CN: 看皮肤和头发、手指、口唇和呼吸——再想想肉眼看不出来的东西怎么测。
hint.en: Look at his skin and hair, his fingers, his lips and his breathing — then think how you would measure what the eye cannot see.

guidance.zh-CN: 他在病房的床上，家长陪在旁边。
guidance.en: He is in a bed on the children's ward, with his parent beside him.

hint.zh-CN: 两个问题要一起想：出血从哪里来、在查明之前怎样保证安全；他身上的其他线索又指向什么。
hint.en: Two questions at once: where the bleeding comes from and how to keep him safe until you know — and what his other clues point to.

title.en: Weigh what the admission results show

hint.zh-CN: 在病历系统调阅免疫学、CT、自身抗体、凝血、心脏超声和淋巴细胞亚群；想清楚每项结果能说明什么、不能说明什么。
hint.en: Read the immunology, CT, autoantibody, clotting, echocardiography and lymphocyte results in the records; work out what each one shows and what it cannot.

guidance.zh-CN: 住院期间的结果已经回报。
guidance.en: The results of the admission are back.

title.en: Agree the plan with the family

hint.zh-CN: 基因结果回来后想一想：他需要哪些长期措施、病变怎么处理、家里人需要知道什么，以及计划能不能真正落实。
hint.en: Once the genetic result is back: what long-term care he needs, what happens to the lesion, what the family needs to know — and whether the plan can actually happen.

hint.zh-CN: 所有决策完成后，半年随访记录会打开；把它和你的计划对照。
hint.en: Once every decision is made, the six-month follow-up opens; compare it with your plan.

prompt.zh-CN: 他一年来咯血5次，每次约50–100 mL，之前住院未查明原因；现在呼吸平稳，未见口唇青紫。入院后的首要安排是什么？
prompt.en: He has coughed up blood five times in the past year, about 50–100 mL each time, and an earlier admission found no cause. He is breathing steadily and his lips are not blue. What is the right plan for his admission?

need.zh-CN: 先问清咯血的经过，并看过他的呼吸和口唇。
need.en: Take the bleeding history and look at his breathing and his lips first.

text.zh-CN: 马上测SpO₂；查血常规、凝血和血型备血，送痰查结核及其他病原；安排增强CT加血管重建；床旁备吸引器和氧气
text.en: Measure his SpO₂ now; send a blood count, clotting and group and save, and sputum for TB and other microbes; arrange contrast CT with vascular reconstruction; suction and oxygen at the bedside

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。一年5次、每次50–100 mL的咯血，上次住院未查明原因，必须找到出血来源；咯血的危险在于气道。口唇不紫不能代表血氧正常：发绀是晚期、不敏感的体征，贫血时出现得更晚，所以要测SpO₂。CT能找到大多数患者的出血原因和部位（CIRSE支气管动脉栓塞实践标准，2022），增强扫描加血管重建还能显示相关血管。在结核常见的地区，痰病原学检查不可少。
feedback.en: Right. Five bleeds of 50–100 mL in a year, unexplained after an earlier admission, need a source, and the danger in haemoptysis is the airway. Lips that are not blue are not a saturation: cyanosis is a late, insensitive sign and appears later still with anaemia, so measure SpO₂. CT identifies the cause and site of bleeding in most patients (CIRSE standards of practice on bronchial artery embolisation, 2022), and contrast with vascular reconstruction shows the vessels involved. Where TB is common, sputum microbiology belongs in the work-up.

text.zh-CN: 首先安排纤维支气管镜，对看到的任何异常部位都取活检，因为只有直视才能找到出血点；CT和血氧饱和度等做完支气管镜再说
text.en: Book flexible bronchoscopy first and biopsy any abnormal area you see, since only direct inspection finds the bleeding point; leave the CT and his oxygen saturation until the bronchoscopy is done

feedback.zh-CN: 只有在需要立即保护气道、控制出血时，支气管镜才排在第一位（CIRSE，2022）；他现在没有出血，应先做CT找到并显示出血来源。对反复咯血的孩子身上性质未明的病变取活检，可能引起大出血；测血氧也不该推迟。
feedback.en: Bronchoscopy comes first only when the airway must be secured and bleeding controlled (CIRSE, 2022); he is not bleeding now, so CT first finds and shows the source. Biopsying an unknown lesion in a child who bleeds can provoke a major haemorrhage, and SpO₂ is never deferred.

text.zh-CN: 今天就开始四联抗结核治疗，因为儿童反复咯血在排除前都应按结核处理；两个月后复查胸片，其他检查到时再说
text.en: Start four-drug anti-tuberculosis treatment today, as recurrent haemoptysis in a child is TB until proved otherwise; repeat a chest X-ray in two months and hold other tests until then

feedback.zh-CN: 结核必须查——痰和其他病原学检查——但没有证据就治疗，会让他服药数月，推迟可能发现血管性或其他结构性病因的CT，也忽视了他皮肤、颈部和牙齿的线索。
feedback.en: TB must be looked for — sputum and other microbiology — but treating without evidence commits him to months of drugs, delays the CT that could show a vascular or other structural source and ignores the clues in his skin, neck and teeth.

text.zh-CN: 他现在不出血、口唇也不紫，说明血氧正常：今天拍胸片，若正常就出院、门诊随访，不必测血氧饱和度
text.en: He is not bleeding and his lips are not blue, so his oxygen is normal: a chest X-ray today, and if it is clear, discharge him to outpatient review without checking his saturation

feedback.zh-CN: 口唇不紫不能说明血氧正常：发绀出现得晚，贫血时更晚。胸片正常也不能排除血管畸形，即使血氧饱和度正常（BTS肺动静脉畸形临床声明，2017，针对成人）。一年5次、每次最多100 mL的不明原因咯血，出院前必须查明原因。
feedback.en: Lips that are not blue do not show a normal SpO₂ — cyanosis appears late, later still with anaemia — and a normal chest X-ray does not exclude a vascular malformation even with normal saturations (BTS clinical statement on pulmonary AVMs, 2017, adults). Five unexplained bleeds of up to 100 mL need a diagnosis before discharge.

prompt.zh-CN: 把他出生后就反复长湿疹、1岁时左颈化脓性淋巴结炎手术、乳牙不脱落而拔牙，以及皮肤所见放在一起。查咯血原因的同时，你要追查哪个诊断？
prompt.en: Put together his eczema since soon after birth, the operation at one for a suppurative gland in his neck, the baby teeth that had to be pulled and what you see on his skin. Alongside the bleeding work-up, which diagnosis do you pursue?

need.zh-CN: 先问他出生后的皮肤情况、严重感染和乳牙，并查看皮肤。
need.en: Ask about his skin since birth, serious infections and his teeth, and look at his skin first.

text.zh-CN: 常染色体显性高IgE综合征（STAT3缺陷）：查IgE、嗜酸性粒细胞、免疫球蛋白和淋巴细胞亚群
text.en: Autosomal dominant hyper-IgE syndrome (STAT3 deficiency): check IgE, eosinophils, immunoglobulins and lymphocyte subsets

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。出生后就反复湿疹、需要手术的化脓性感染、乳牙不脱落，是STAT3高IgE综合征的组合；乳牙滞留属于常染色体显性型，AAAAI/ACAAI原发性免疫缺陷实践参数（2015）建议拔除滞留乳牙。IgE和嗜酸性粒细胞支持诊断；STAT3缺陷时IgG、IgA、IgM总量和淋巴细胞总数通常正常（Tsilifis等，2021），这些检查主要用来排除其他免疫缺陷。
feedback.en: Right. Eczema from soon after birth, a suppurative infection that needed surgery and baby teeth that would not shed are the pattern of STAT3 hyper-IgE syndrome; retained primary teeth belong to the dominant form, and the AAAAI/ACAAI practice parameter on primary immunodeficiency (2015) advises extracting them. IgE and eosinophils support it; total IgG, IgA and IgM and the total lymphocyte count are usually normal in STAT3 deficiency (Tsilifis et al., 2021), so those tests mainly exclude other defects.

text.zh-CN: DOCK8缺陷（常染色体隐性高IgE综合征）：查IgE、嗜酸性粒细胞和T细胞数量，并寻找病毒性皮肤感染
text.en: DOCK8 deficiency (autosomal recessive hyper-IgE syndrome): check IgE, eosinophils and T-cell numbers, and look for viral skin infections

feedback.zh-CN: DOCK8缺陷也有湿疹和高IgE，但以严重过敏和广泛的病毒性皮肤感染为主，没有牙齿和骨骼异常（AAAAI/ACAAI，2015）。乳牙不脱落指向STAT3型。
feedback.en: DOCK8 deficiency also brings eczema and a high IgE, but with severe allergies and widespread viral skin infections — and without dental or skeletal abnormalities (AAAAI/ACAAI, 2015). Baby teeth that would not shed point to the STAT3 form.

text.zh-CN: Wiskott–Aldrich综合征（X连锁）：男孩湿疹、化脓性感染加出血，查血小板计数和血小板大小
text.en: Wiskott–Aldrich syndrome (X-linked): eczema, a pus-forming infection and bleeding in a boy, so check the platelet count and size

feedback.zh-CN: Wiskott–Aldrich综合征把湿疹、感染与血小板减少引起的出血（瘀点、瘀斑、便血）联系在一起，与乳牙滞留无关。操作前查血小板依然正确，但这里的组合指向STAT3高IgE综合征。
feedback.en: Wiskott–Aldrich syndrome links eczema and infections to bleeding from a low platelet count — petechiae, bruising, bloody stools — not to retained baby teeth. Checking platelets before any procedure is still right, but this pattern points to STAT3 hyper-IgE syndrome.

text.zh-CN: 慢性肉芽肿病：婴儿期需要手术的化脓性淋巴结炎提示吞噬细胞缺陷，查中性粒细胞呼吸爆发（DHR）
text.en: Chronic granulomatous disease: a suppurative node needing surgery in infancy points to a phagocyte defect, so test the neutrophil oxidative burst (DHR)

feedback.zh-CN: 慢性肉芽肿病确实会引起化脓性淋巴结炎，但出生后就反复的湿疹和乳牙不脱落不是它的特点；三者合在一起指向STAT3高IgE综合征。
feedback.en: Chronic granulomatous disease does cause suppurative lymphadenitis, but eczema from soon after birth and baby teeth that fail to shed are not part of its picture; together the three point to STAT3 hyper-IgE syndrome.

prompt.zh-CN: CT示右肺结节内有强化血管。针对这个病变，下一步怎么做？
prompt.en: The CT shows enhancing vessels within nodules in his right lung. What is the next step for this lesion?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅CT报告和凝血结果。
need.en: Read the CT report and the clotting results first.

text.zh-CN: 转介入放射科：肺动脉和支气管动脉造影，明确供血血管并同期栓塞；术前查血小板计数并预防性用抗生素
text.en: Interventional radiology: angiography of both the pulmonary and the bronchial arteries, embolising the feeding vessels in one session, after a platelet count and with antibiotic cover

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。两套循环的血管造影能回答CT留下的问题——是肺动静脉畸形，还是支气管（体循环）动脉—肺血管瘘——并可同期治疗。BTS肺动静脉畸形临床声明（2017，针对成人）主张：技术可行时，所有影像可见的肺动静脉畸形都转介栓塞，没有“3 mm以下不处理”的规则；CIRSE实践标准（2022）对反复咯血且见病理性动脉者行栓塞。凝血记录为未见异常，但血小板计数没有记录；BTS建议栓塞时预防性使用抗生素。
feedback.en: Right. Angiography of both circulations answers the question the CT leaves open — a pulmonary arteriovenous malformation or a bronchial (systemic) artery–to–pulmonary fistula — and treats it in the same session. The BTS clinical statement on pulmonary AVMs (2017, for adults) refers every radiologically visible PAVM for embolisation if technically feasible, with no '3 mm rule'; the CIRSE standards of practice (2022) embolise pathological arteries in recurrent haemoptysis. Clotting is reported as unremarkable but the platelet count is not recorded; BTS advises antibiotic cover for embolisation.

text.zh-CN: 在CT引导下对右肺其中一个结节穿刺活检，先用组织学区分是血管性、炎症性还是真菌性病变，再决定怎么治疗
text.en: A CT-guided needle biopsy of one of the right-lung nodules, so that histology can separate a vascular from an inflammatory or fungal lesion before anyone decides on treatment or refers him on

feedback.zh-CN: 对强化如血管的病变穿刺，可引起大出血，若存在右向左分流还可导致空气栓塞。CT阳性即可诊断肺动静脉畸形（BTS，2017）；血管病变靠血管造影明确，不需要组织。
feedback.en: Needling a lesion that enhances like a vessel risks massive haemorrhage and, through a right-to-left shunt, air embolism. A positive CT is diagnostic of a PAVM (BTS, 2017); angiography, not tissue, defines a vascular lesion.

text.zh-CN: 转胸外科切除病变所在的右肺，既能去除出血来源，又能取得组织，确定是肺还是支气管动静脉瘘
text.en: Thoracic surgery to resect the affected right lung, which removes the bleeding source and gives tissue to show whether the fistula is pulmonary or bronchial

feedback.zh-CN: 切除会丢掉本可经栓塞保留的肺组织。BTS（2017）对影像可见的肺动静脉畸形主张转介栓塞，CIRSE（2022）把开胸手术留给破坏性肺病或栓塞失败；STAT3高IgE综合征患者肺部手术易出现支气管胸膜瘘等并发症（Tsilifis等，2021）。
feedback.en: Resection sacrifices lung that embolisation would spare. BTS (2017) refers visible PAVMs for embolisation and CIRSE (2022) keeps open surgery for destructive lung disease or failed embolisation; in STAT3 hyper-IgE syndrome lung surgery risks complications such as bronchopleural fistula (Tsilifis et al., 2021).

text.zh-CN: 他现在不出血，暂不做任何操作：一年后复查CT，只有再咯血或结节增大时才转诊治疗
text.en: No procedure while he is not bleeding: repeat the CT in a year and refer for treatment only if the bleeding returns or the nodules grow

feedback.zh-CN: 反复咯血、每次最多100 mL、病变性质不明，不宜观察等待：CIRSE（2022）对反复咯血且见病理性动脉者行栓塞；BTS声明（2017，针对成人）即使无症状也建议治疗影像可见的肺动静脉畸形，并且不主张按计划反复做CT（辐射负担）。
feedback.en: Recurrent bleeds of up to 100 mL from a lesion of unknown type are not for watching: CIRSE (2022) embolises pathological arteries in recurrent haemoptysis, and the BTS statement (2017, for adults) recommends treating visible PAVMs even without symptoms — and advises against repeating CT by protocol, given the radiation.

prompt.zh-CN: 他的IgE >3.0×10⁶ IU/L。你怎样证实诊断？
prompt.en: His IgE is above 3.0×10⁶ IU/L. How do you confirm the diagnosis?

text.zh-CN: 对他做STAT3基因测序，发现变异后验证父母，并在检测前后向家人解释结果的意义
text.en: Sequence STAT3 in him, test both parents for any variant found, and explain before and after what a result can mean

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。Woellner等的诊断指南（2010）：IgE >1000 IU/mL加加权临床评分>30为“可能”，再有Th17细胞缺如或家族史为“很可能”，检出显性负性的STAT3杂合变异才“确诊”。他的IgE >3.0×10⁶ IU/L，即>3000 IU/mL。验证父母能区分遗传与新发（de novo），这是遗传咨询的关键。
feedback.en: Right. Woellner and colleagues' diagnostic guidelines (2010) call STAT3 hyper-IgE syndrome possible with IgE > 1000 IU/mL and a weighted clinical score > 30, probable with absent Th17 cells or a family history, and definitive only with a dominant-negative heterozygous STAT3 variant. His > 3.0×10⁶ IU/L is > 3000 IU/mL. Testing the parents separates inherited from new (de novo) — the key to counselling.

text.zh-CN: 不需要再做基因检测：IgE这么高，再加上湿疹和感染，本身就足以确诊高IgE综合征
text.en: No gene test is needed: an IgE this high, with eczema and infections, is diagnostic of hyper-IgE syndrome on its own

feedback.zh-CN: IgE达数千并不特异：重度特应性皮炎更常引起极高的IgE（AAAAI/ACAAI，2015）。确诊需要临床表现加STAT3变异（Woellner，2010）。
feedback.en: An IgE in the thousands is not specific: severe atopic dermatitis is a commoner cause of extreme IgE (AAAAI/ACAAI, 2015). The diagnosis rests on the clinical picture plus a STAT3 variant (Woellner, 2010).

text.zh-CN: 查Th17细胞：如果缺如，诊断即已确立，不必再做STAT3测序
text.en: Count his Th17 cells: if they are absent, the diagnosis is proven and STAT3 sequencing adds nothing

feedback.zh-CN: Th17细胞缺如只能把诊断提升到“很可能”，还不是“确诊”（Woellner，2010）；变异本身才能确诊，也是家庭遗传咨询的依据。
feedback.en: Absent Th17 cells make the diagnosis probable, not definitive (Woellner, 2010); the variant itself confirms it and grounds the family's counselling.

text.zh-CN: 半年后复查IgE和嗜酸性粒细胞，两者仍高时再考虑基因检测
text.en: Repeat IgE and eosinophils in six months, and request genetic testing only if both are still raised

feedback.zh-CN: 等半年会推迟一个现在就改变处理的诊断——感染预防、牙科和操作前的安排；IgE已超过3.0×10⁶ IU/L，复查不会增加信息。
feedback.en: Waiting six months delays a diagnosis that changes care now — infection prophylaxis, dental and procedure planning — and repeating an IgE already above 3.0×10⁶ IU/L adds nothing.

prompt.zh-CN: STAT3检测结果已回报。出院前，团队应和他及家长商定什么计划？
prompt.en: The STAT3 result is back. Which plan should the team agree with him and his parent before discharge?

text.zh-CN: 免疫科随访，抗葡萄球菌预防加皮肤护理；安排栓塞；牙科操作前用抗生素；书面再咯血预案；遗传咨询；帮助解决费用
text.en: Immunology follow-up with anti-staphylococcal prophylaxis and skin care; embolisation planned; antibiotic cover before dental work; a written bleeding plan; genetic counselling; help with costs

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。STAT3高IgE综合征是终身疾病：AAAAI/ACAAI实践参数（2015）主张以处理并发症为中心，积极使用治疗性和预防性抗生素；Tsilifis等（2021）建议复方磺胺甲噁唑每日2次，并做抗菌的皮肤护理。血管病变仍需造影和栓塞；可能存在肺动静脉畸形时，牙科和外科操作前要预防性使用抗生素（BTS，2017）——对已经因乳牙不脱落拔过牙的孩子尤其相关。书面的再咯血计划、针对新发显性变异的遗传咨询（他的每个孩子都有50%的机会遗传）和费用上的帮助，计划才能落实。
feedback.en: Right. STAT3 hyper-IgE syndrome is lifelong: the AAAAI/ACAAI practice parameter (2015) directs care at managing complications, with aggressive therapeutic and prophylactic antibiotics, and Tsilifis and colleagues (2021) suggest twice-daily co-trimoxazole with antiseptic skin care. The lesion still needs angiography and embolisation; with a possible PAVM, antibiotic cover before dental and surgical procedures (BTS, 2017) matters for a boy who has already needed baby teeth pulled. A written bleeding plan, counselling about a new dominant variant (each of his children has a 50 % chance of inheriting it) and help with costs make the plan work.

text.zh-CN: 如果今后几个月不再咯血，就视为肺部病变已经愈合，结束呼吸科和介入科的随访，只在免疫科门诊继续湿疹的皮肤护理
text.en: If he has no more bleeding over the coming months, regard the lung lesion as healed, close respiratory and interventional follow-up, and keep only the skin care for his eczema in the immunology clinic

feedback.zh-CN: 出血停止不等于病变消失：血管畸形及其类型仍未解决，右向左分流的风险不只是出血，还有反常栓塞和脑脓肿（BTS，2017）。病变治疗前随访不能停。
feedback.en: Bleeding that stops does not remove the lesion: the malformation and its type are unresolved, and a right-to-left shunt carries risks beyond bleeding — paradoxical embolism and brain abscess (BTS, 2017). Follow-up continues until it is treated.

text.zh-CN: 父母都没有这个变异，可以告诉他：他将来的孩子不会遗传这个病，以后也不需要任何遗传随访或咨询
text.en: Since neither parent carries the variant, reassure him that his own future children cannot inherit it and that no genetic counselling or follow-up will ever be needed

feedback.zh-CN: 父母都阴性，说明变异很可能是在他身上新发生的——但他现在携带它，显性变异传给他每个孩子的机会都是50%。对父母将来再生育，风险低但不是零（生殖腺嵌合）。
feedback.en: Parents who both test negative make the variant most likely new (de novo) in him — but he now carries it, and a dominant variant passes to each of his children with a 50 % chance. For his parents' future children the risk is low but not nil (germline mosaicism).

text.zh-CN: 不用常规预防用药，感染发生时再治疗；血管病变的处理推迟到他成年以后，再由成人科决定
text.en: No regular prophylaxis — treat infections only when they happen — and put off any treatment of the lung lesion until he is an adult and an adult team can decide

feedback.zh-CN: 等感染发生再治疗，会招来STAT3高IgE综合征常见的肺炎及其肺损害（肺气囊、支气管扩张），预防是推荐做法（AAAAI/ACAAI，2015；Tsilifis等，2021）。把血管病变推迟到成年，等于让他继续承受每次最多100 mL的咯血风险。
feedback.en: Waiting for infections invites the pneumonias — and the lung damage, pneumatoceles and bronchiectasis — that STAT3 hyper-IgE syndrome makes likely; prophylaxis is advised (AAAAI/ACAAI, 2015; Tsilifis et al., 2021). Deferring the lesion to adulthood leaves him exposed to further bleeds of up to 100 mL.

text.zh-CN: 问清咯血病史：病程、次数、每次的量，以及上次住院的结论
text.en: Took the bleeding history: duration, number of episodes, volume each time and what the earlier admission found

text.zh-CN: 询问出生后的皮肤、需要手术的感染、乳牙和家族史
text.en: Asked about his skin since birth, the infection that needed surgery, his baby teeth and the family

text.zh-CN: 检查皮肤和头发、手指、口唇及呼吸
text.en: Examined his skin and hair, fingers, lips and breathing

text.zh-CN: 入院时就测SpO₂，没有凭口唇不紫认定血氧正常
text.en: Measured SpO₂ on admission instead of reading normal oxygenation from lips that are not blue

text.zh-CN: 入院处理计划第一次即选对
text.en: Chose the admission plan for his haemoptysis correctly at the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 把皮肤、感染和牙齿线索联系到免疫综合征（第一次即答对）
text.en: Linked the skin, infection and dental clues to an immune syndrome (first attempt)

text.zh-CN: 调阅全部入院结果：免疫学、CT、自身抗体、凝血、心脏超声和淋巴细胞亚群
text.en: Reviewed every admission result: immunology, CT, autoantibodies, clotting, echocardiography and lymphocyte subsets

text.zh-CN: 肺部病变的明确和处理方式第一次即选对
text.en: Chose how to define and treat the lung lesion correctly at the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 读完CT后、出院前转介介入放射科行血管造影和栓塞
text.en: Referred to interventional radiology for angiography and embolisation after reading the CT and before discharge

text.zh-CN: 证实免疫诊断的方法第一次即选对
text.en: Chose how to confirm the immune diagnosis correctly at the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 出院计划第一次即选对
text.en: Chose the discharge plan correctly at the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 落实今天的措施：大咯血预案、静脉防进气、预防用药、操作前抗生素和遗传咨询
text.en: Put today's care in place: a large-bleed plan, air-free IV lines, prophylaxis, procedure antibiotic cover and genetic counselling

text.zh-CN: 没有对强化如血管的肺部病变做活检
text.en: Did not biopsy a lung lesion that enhances like a blood vessel

text.zh-CN: 没有把肺切除当作首选，也没有不安排随访就让他出院
text.en: Avoided lung resection as a first-line treatment and discharge without follow-up

text.zh-CN: 和孩子及家长沟通病情、坏消息和计划，并核实理解
text.en: Talked the boy and his parent through the findings, the news and the plan, and checked understanding

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 按Calgary–Cambridge评估：问候孩子和家长；咯血的经过让孩子自己说，婴幼儿期、颈部手术和乳牙由家长补充；解释正在查咯血原因，以及为什么即使口唇不紫也要测血氧。基因结果回来时用SPIKES告知坏消息：这是一种终身但可以管理的免疫病；父母都没有检出这个变异，它很可能是在他身上新发生的（不要让父母自责）；他将来的每个孩子有50%的机会遗传。说明肺部病变仍需造影、很可能需要栓塞，牙科操作前要用抗生素，再咯血时怎么办；坦诚地询问费用顾虑，介绍社工和医保。用回授法确认理解。不要承诺不会再咯血，也不要把病变类型说成已经确定。原报告没有记录和家属的沟通。
judgeGuidance.en: Calgary–Cambridge: greet the boy and his parent; let the boy describe the bleeding in his own words and the parent fill in infancy, the neck operation and the teeth; explain that the cause of the bleeding is being looked for and why his oxygen will be measured even though his lips are not blue. When the STAT3 result is back, break the news with SPIKES: a lifelong but manageable immune condition; the variant was not found in either parent, so it most likely arose in him (no blame); each of his future children has a 50 % chance of inheriting it. Explain that the lung lesion still needs angiography and probably embolisation, that dental work needs antibiotic cover, and what to do if he coughs up blood again; ask openly about cost and offer the social worker and insurance help. Check understanding by teach-back. Do not promise that the bleeding will not come back, and do not present the lesion's type as settled. The report records no conversation with the family.

name.zh-CN: 儿科带教老师

knowledge.zh-CN: 这是一份按时间推进的历史病例：入院时的咯血病史和床旁评估、住院检查结果、基因结果与出院计划，最后是半年随访。按学员所处的阶段做苏格拉底式提问：入院时——口唇不紫能说明血氧吗？哪些小时候的经历重要？读过CT后——为什么不能给强化如血管的病变穿刺？肺动静脉瘘和支气管动静脉瘘怎么区分，哪项检查能回答？读过基因结果后——它对他本人、父母和他将来的孩子意味着什么？只用记录的事实：SpO₂没有测；血小板和白细胞计数、体重、生命体征、结节数目和大小都没有记录——不要替它们补数。学员还没看到的结果不要提前说，随访结果更不能提前透露。学员作出相应决策之前，不要说出诊断或该决策的答案。复盘用PEARLS。
knowledge.en: A historical teaching case that moves through one admission: the bleeding history and bedside assessment, the admission results, the genetic result and the discharge plan, then the six-month follow-up. Ask Socratic questions that fit the stage the learner has reached: on admission — what do lips that are not blue tell you about his oxygen, and which childhood facts matter? With the CT read — why not put a needle into a lesion that enhances like a vessel, what separates a pulmonary from a bronchial arteriovenous fistula, and which test answers it? With the genetic result read — what does it mean for him, his parents and his future children? Use recorded facts only: SpO₂ was not measured, and the platelet and white counts, his weight, his vital signs and the number and size of the nodules are not recorded — do not supply them. Do not reveal a result before the learner has read it, and never reveal the follow-up early. Never state the diagnosis or a decision's answer before the learner has made that decision. Debrief with PEARLS.

name.zh-CN: 儿科病房护士

knowledge.zh-CN: 儿科病房护士，用ISBAR交班：12岁男孩，间断咯血1年，一年5次、每次约50–100 mL，之前住院未查明原因，家长陪同；生命体征还没有记录，体重也没有记录。可以协助接监护仪、床旁备吸引器和氧气、建立静脉通路和抽血送检；按体重给药前会提醒先称体重并确认过敏史。
knowledge.en: Children's ward nurse; hands over with ISBAR: a 12-year-old boy with a year of intermittent haemoptysis — five episodes of about 50–100 mL — that an earlier admission did not explain, here with his parent; no observations are recorded yet and his weight is not recorded. Can attach the monitor, set up suction and oxygen at the bedside, site a cannula and send bloods; before any weight-based drug, asks for a weight and an allergy check.

name.zh-CN: 影像科医生

knowledge.zh-CN: 学员拿到CT报告后，能解释报告：右肺结节内见强化血管，部分有肺动静脉伴行，提示血管发育畸形，肺动静脉瘘可能。说明CT不一定能区分肺动静脉畸形和支气管（体循环）动脉—肺血管瘘，肺动脉和支气管动脉的导管造影能显示两套循环；报告里没有结节数目、大小和血管直径。被问到穿刺活检时，说明对强化如血管的病变穿刺有出血风险。
knowledge.en: Once the learner has the CT report, can explain it: enhancing vessels within nodules in the right lung, partly accompanied by pulmonary arteries/veins, suggesting a developmental vascular malformation, possibly a pulmonary arteriovenous fistula. Explains that CT cannot always tell a pulmonary AVM from a bronchial (systemic) artery–to–pulmonary fistula and that catheter angiography of the pulmonary and bronchial arteries shows both circulations; the report gives no number, size or vessel diameter. If asked about a biopsy, explains the bleeding risk of needling a lesion that enhances like a vessel.

name.zh-CN: 儿童免疫科医生

knowledge.zh-CN: 学员拿到结果后帮助解读免疫学、淋巴细胞亚群和基因检测，不主动给出诊断。熟悉现行做法：高IgE不特异；STAT3高IgE综合征时IgG、IgA、IgM和淋巴细胞总数通常正常；诊断按Woellner指南（2010）分级；长期管理包括抗葡萄球菌预防（复方磺胺甲噁唑按体重给药——他的体重没有记录）、皮肤护理、滞留乳牙的处理、脊柱侧弯和轻微外伤骨折的监测；有肺实质病变时可考虑抗霉菌唑类预防；免疫球蛋白替代用于特定患者，造血干细胞移植是可以考虑的选项。
knowledge.en: Helps interpret the immunology, lymphocyte and genetic results once the learner has them, without volunteering a diagnosis. Knows current practice: a high IgE is not specific; in STAT3 hyper-IgE syndrome IgG, IgA, IgM and the total lymphocyte count are usually normal; the diagnosis is graded by the Woellner guidelines (2010); long-term care means anti-staphylococcal prophylaxis (co-trimoxazole dosed by weight — his weight is not recorded), skin care, managing retained primary teeth, and watching for scoliosis and minimal-trauma fractures; a mould-active azole considered when there is parenchymal lung disease; immunoglobulin replacement in selected patients, and haematopoietic stem-cell transplantation as an option to consider.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：反复咯血与STAT3高IgE综合征
title.en: Debrief: recurrent haemoptysis and STAT3 hyper-IgE syndrome

conclusion.zh-CN: 12岁男孩间断咯血1年，一年5次、每次约50–100 mL，之前住院未查明原因。病史里藏着第二个诊断：出生后就反复长湿疹，累及躯干、四肢和面颈部；1岁时因左颈化脓性淋巴结炎手术；3年前因乳牙不脱落拔除乳牙；体格和智力发育与同龄儿相同，家族史未见特殊。查体见散在色素脱失、面部瘢痕、小片脱发和杵状指；呼吸平稳，未见口唇青紫，但没有测SpO₂。IgE >3.0×10⁶ IU/L（参考值<1.0×10⁵），其他免疫球蛋白正常，嗜酸性粒细胞0.086，血红蛋白111 g/L；ANA、dsDNA、ANCA阴性，凝血、心脏超声和CD系列（淋巴细胞亚群）未见异常。增强CT及血管重建示右肺结节内强化血管，部分有肺动静脉伴行，提示血管发育畸形、肺动静脉瘘可能。STAT3基因c.1909G>A（p.V637M）杂合变异，父母未检出，报告认为具有致病意义：STAT3相关高IgE综合征合并疑似肺血管畸形，血管类型未定。因经济困难未手术；半年电话随访未再咯血，肺动静脉瘘与支气管动静脉瘘的区分未完成。
conclusion.en: A 12-year-old boy had a year of intermittent haemoptysis — five episodes of about 50–100 mL — that an earlier admission had not explained. His history held a second diagnosis: recurrent eczema of the trunk, limbs, face and neck since soon after birth, an operation at one year for left cervical suppurative lymphadenitis, and primary teeth extracted three years earlier because they had not shed; his physical and intellectual development matched his peers' and the family history was unremarkable. He had scattered depigmentation, facial scars, small patches of hair loss and finger clubbing; his breathing was steady and no cyanosis of the lips was seen, but SpO₂ was not measured. IgE was > 3.0×10⁶ IU/L (reference < 1.0×10⁵) with the other immunoglobulins normal, eosinophils 0.086 and haemoglobin 111 g/L; ANA, dsDNA and ANCA were negative, and coagulation, echocardiography and the CD series (lymphocyte subsets) showed no abnormality. Contrast CT with vascular reconstruction showed enhancing vessels within right-lung nodules, partly accompanied by pulmonary arteries/veins, suggesting a developmental vascular malformation — possibly a pulmonary arteriovenous fistula. STAT3 testing found a heterozygous c.1909G>A (p.V637M) variant, not detected in his parents, which the report considered pathogenic: STAT3-related hyper-IgE syndrome with a suspected pulmonary vascular malformation of uncertain type. No operation was performed because of financial difficulty; at the six-month telephone follow-up he had not coughed up blood again, and whether the lesion was a pulmonary or a bronchial arteriovenous fistula remained unresolved.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 反复咯血、之前住院未查明：先做好大咯血预案，再用增强CT加血管重建找出血来源。
keyReasoning.en: Recurrent haemoptysis that an earlier admission did not explain: prepare for a large bleed, then find the source with contrast CT and vascular reconstruction.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 杵状指、没测SpO₂、血红蛋白111 g/L：口唇不紫代替不了测量。
keyReasoning.en: Clubbing, no SpO₂ and a haemoglobin of 111 g/L: lips that are not blue cannot stand in for a measurement.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 出生后湿疹 + 需手术的化脓性感染 + 乳牙不脱落 + IgE >3.0×10⁶ IU/L → STAT3高IgE综合征；DOCK8缺陷没有牙齿和骨骼表现。
keyReasoning.en: Eczema from soon after birth + a suppurative infection needing surgery + retained baby teeth + IgE > 3.0×10⁶ IU/L → STAT3 hyper-IgE syndrome; DOCK8 deficiency lacks the dental and skeletal features.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 结节内有强化血管 → 不穿刺；两套循环的血管造影既能分型，又能同期栓塞。
keyReasoning.en: Enhancing vessels inside the nodules → no needle; angiography of both circulations types the lesion and can embolise it at once.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: STAT3变异确立免疫诊断，却说明不了血管解剖；父母阴性 → 变异很可能在他身上新发，他的每个孩子有50%的机会遗传。
keyReasoning.en: The STAT3 variant settles the immune diagnosis but not the vascular anatomy; parents negative → most likely new in him, and each of his children has a 50 % chance of inheriting it.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 因经济困难未手术：计划要把费用考虑进去。
keyReasoning.en: No operation because of financial difficulty: a plan has to include what it costs the family.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单个病例报告：不能据此比较栓塞与手术，也不能确定血管病变的类型。原报告的经过作为历史事实记录；决策、处置选项和评分依据现行指导意见设计，是教学设计。病例事实来自1.0.0版的提取，尚未对照原文全文核对。
boundaries.en: This is a single case report: it cannot compare embolisation with surgery, and it cannot settle the type of the vascular lesion. The report's course is kept as historical fact; the decisions, management options and scoring follow current guidance and are teaching design. The facts are the extraction recorded in version 1.0.0 and have not yet been checked against the full source article.

unknowns.zh-CN: SpO₂（没有测）、生命体征、体重和身高。
unknowns.en: SpO₂ (not measured), vital signs, weight and height.

unknowns.zh-CN: 血小板和白细胞计数、嗜酸性粒细胞绝对计数、IgG/IgA/IgM各自数值和Th17细胞。
unknowns.en: The platelet and white-cell counts, the absolute eosinophil count, the individual IgG, IgA and IgM values, and Th17 cells.

unknowns.zh-CN: 结节的数目、大小和供血血管直径；是否评估了支气管动脉；有没有做血管造影或右心声学造影。
unknowns.en: The number and size of the nodules and the feeding-vessel diameters; whether the bronchial arteries were assessed; whether angiography or a bubble-contrast echocardiogram was ever done.

unknowns.zh-CN: 颈部淋巴结炎以外的感染史（肺炎、皮肤脓肿、真菌感染）、骨折、脊柱侧弯和面容特征——NIH评分和Woellner加权评分都无法计算。
unknowns.en: Infections other than the neck lymphadenitis (pneumonia, skin abscesses, fungal infection), fractures, scoliosis and facial features — neither the NIH score nor the Woellner weighted score can be calculated.

unknowns.zh-CN: 鼻出血、毛细血管扩张等遗传性出血性毛细血管扩张症的线索，以及痰病原学和结核检测。

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 血氧要测，不能看出来。发绀要等去氧血红蛋白相当多时才出现，血红蛋白低时出现得更晚——他的血红蛋白111 g/L，低于WHO《血红蛋白贫血切点指南》（2024）中12–14岁儿童的贫血切点120 g/L。BTS肺动静脉畸形临床声明（2017）也指出，肺动静脉畸形引起的低氧血症通常没有症状。原报告没有测SpO₂；今天，有杵状指、可能存在右向左分流的孩子入院时就应测SpO₂。
teachingPoints.en: Oxygen is measured, not seen. Cyanosis needs a large amount of deoxygenated haemoglobin and appears later still when haemoglobin is low — his 111 g/L is below the anaemia cut-off of 120 g/L for children aged 12–14 in the WHO guideline on haemoglobin cut-offs (2024) — and the BTS clinical statement on pulmonary AVMs (2017) notes that the hypoxaemia they cause is usually asymptomatic. The report did not measure SpO₂; today a child with clubbing and a possible right-to-left shunt has it measured on admission.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 肺动静脉畸形是右向左分流。BTS肺动静脉畸形临床声明（Shovlin等，2017；因儿童资料不足，针对16岁以上成人）：技术可行时所有影像可见的肺动静脉畸形都转介栓塞，即使没有症状，也没有“3 mm规则”；牙科、内镜、外科和栓塞等操作前预防性使用抗生素；胸片正常、即使血氧正常也不能排除；CT阳性即可诊断；每个肺动静脉畸形患者都要考虑遗传性出血性毛细血管扩张症（本例鼻出血和毛细血管扩张都没有记录）。原报告做了CT和基因检测，没有记录血管造影；因经济困难未手术。
teachingPoints.en: A PAVM is a right-to-left shunt. The BTS clinical statement on pulmonary AVMs (Shovlin et al., 2017; written for adults over 16 because data in children are sparse) refers every radiologically visible PAVM for embolisation if technically feasible, even without symptoms and with no '3 mm rule'; gives antibiotic cover before dental, endoscopic, surgical and embolisation procedures; holds that a normal chest X-ray, even with normal saturations, does not exclude one; treats a positive CT as diagnostic; and asks for hereditary haemorrhagic telangiectasia to be considered in every patient with PAVMs (nosebleeds and telangiectasia are not recorded here). The report reached CT and genetics; no angiography was recorded, and no operation was performed because of financial difficulty.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 支气管动脉还是肺动脉？CIRSE支气管动脉栓塞实践标准（2022）：反复或危及生命的咯血、见到病理性动脉时行栓塞；危及生命的咯血先做CT血管成像；未见支气管动脉异常时要排除肺动脉瘤、肺动静脉畸形和瘘；开胸手术留给破坏性肺病或栓塞失败。STAT3高IgE综合征本身也有血管病变：胸内动脉假性动脉瘤可引起大咯血，需要血管内治疗（Tsilifis等，2021）——本例病变与该综合征是否相关并不确定。“肺动静脉瘘还是支气管动静脉瘘”的问题，正是两套循环的血管造影要回答的。
teachingPoints.en: Bronchial or pulmonary? The CIRSE standards of practice on bronchial artery embolisation (2022) embolise pathological arteries in recurrent or life-threatening haemoptysis, put CT angiography first in life-threatening bleeding, look for pulmonary artery aneurysms, PAVMs and fistulas when the bronchial arteries are normal, and keep open surgery for destructive lung disease or failed embolisation. The syndrome has vascular disease of its own: in STAT3 hyper-IgE syndrome intrathoracic arterial pseudoaneurysms can cause massive haemoptysis that needs endovascular treatment (Tsilifis et al., 2021) — whether this boy's lesion is related to the syndrome is not established. His open question, a pulmonary or a bronchial arteriovenous fistula, is exactly what angiography of both circulations answers.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 诊断STAT3高IgE综合征。IgE达数千并不特异，重度特应性皮炎更常见（AAAAI/ACAAI原发性免疫缺陷实践参数，2015）。Woellner诊断指南（2010）：IgE >1000 IU/mL加加权评分>30为“可能”，Th17缺如或家族史为“很可能”，显性负性STAT3杂合变异为“确诊”。他的c.1909G>A（p.V637M）位于SH2结构域，在该研究队列中见于10例患者。
teachingPoints.en: Diagnosing STAT3 hyper-IgE syndrome. An IgE in the thousands is not specific — severe atopic dermatitis is the commoner cause (AAAAI/ACAAI practice parameter on primary immunodeficiency, 2015). Woellner's diagnostic guidelines (2010): possible with IgE > 1000 IU/mL and a weighted score > 30, probable with absent Th17 cells or a family history, definitive with a dominant-negative heterozygous STAT3 variant. His c.1909G>A (p.V637M) lies in the SH2 domain and was carried by 10 patients in that cohort.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 终身管理。AAAAI/ACAAI（2015）：处理以并发症为中心——积极的治疗性和预防性抗生素，可考虑抗真菌预防，预防轻微外伤骨折，监测脊柱侧弯，拔除滞留乳牙。Tsilifis等（2021）的综述建议复方磺胺甲噁唑每日2次和抗菌皮肤护理；有支气管扩张、肺气囊等肺实质病变时可考虑抗霉菌唑类预防；肺部手术易出现支气管胸膜瘘。原报告没有记录预防用药。
teachingPoints.en: Lifelong care. AAAAI/ACAAI (2015): direct care at complications — aggressive therapeutic and prophylactic antibiotics, consider antifungal prophylaxis, prevent minimal-trauma fractures, watch for scoliosis, extract retained primary teeth. The review by Tsilifis and colleagues (2021) suggests twice-daily co-trimoxazole with antiseptic skin care, considers a mould-active azole when there is parenchymal lung disease such as bronchiectasis or pneumatoceles, and warns that lung surgery risks bronchopleural fistula. The report records no prophylaxis.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 父母阴性意味着什么。ACMG/AMP变异解读标准（2015）：新发变异只有在亲子关系经过确认时才算强证据（PS2），否则为中等证据（PM6）——本例未记录亲子关系是否确认。显性遗传：他的每个孩子有50%的机会遗传；父母再生育的风险低但不为零（生殖腺嵌合）。
teachingPoints.en: What negative parents mean. The ACMG/AMP standards for interpreting sequence variants (2015) count a de novo variant as strong evidence only when parentage is confirmed (PS2), otherwise as moderate (PM6) — and confirmation is not recorded here. Dominant inheritance: each of his children has a 50 % chance; his parents' risk in a future pregnancy is low but not nil (germline mosaicism).
